behavior: reads a runtime counter via double indirection through the fixed cell Data_03001ef8 (a pointer-to-pointer style global); returns immediately if the value is above 79 (unsigned)
tile id = (value & 7) + 0xf081; row = 13 - (value / 8, rounded toward -inf via the classic '(v>=0?v:v+7)>>3' idiom); fills all 32 halfwords of that VRAM row with the tile id

second pass: same division recomputed (redundant re-evaluation, matching this corpus's established double-read idiom), row = (value/8) + 13; if that row exceeds 20 (unsigned) the function returns without the second write; otherwise fills that row with tile id | 0x800
